biography: Jonny Edgar, a name now synonymous with defensive prowess and calculated risk, didn't exactly burst onto the motorsport scene. Growing up in a small village nestled in the Cotswolds, his initial passion was tinkering with his grandfather's vintage tractors. It wasn't until his late teens, during a family trip to Silverstone, that the roar of engines ignited a different kind of mechanical fascination. He started in karting, quickly gaining a reputation for his near-impenetrable defensive lines. A defining moment came during a particularly wet race at Brands Hatch, where, despite starting last, he held off a charging pack of faster karts for nearly half the race, showcasing his uncanny ability to anticipate and block overtakes. Now in his peak years, Jonny finds himself campaigning the demanding Ligier JS P217, a testament to his relentless drive and his consistent, if not always spectacular, performances.
drivingStyle: Jonny's driving style is best described as 'the immovable object.' He's not the flashiest driver on the grid; instead, he focuses on minimizing mistakes and maximizing defensive positioning. He meticulously studies track data, identifying optimal braking points and lines to make overtaking attempts as difficult as possible. Tire management is another key strength – he can nurse a set of tires for an astonishingly long time, often gaining positions in the closing stages of a race as others struggle with degradation. He thrives under pressure, often performing at his best when defending a crucial position.

rivalries.name: Isabelle Rossi
rivalries.reason: A constant thorn in Edgar's side, Rossi's aggressive overtaking style clashes directly with Edgar's defensive tactics, leading to numerous on-track altercations.

rivalries.name: Kenji Tanaka
rivalries.reason: Tanaka, known for his raw speed, often finds himself frustrated by Edgar's ability to strategically block and outmaneuver him, leading to heated exchanges in post-race interviews.

rivalries.name: Ricardo Alvarez
rivalries.reason: Alvarez and Edgar have a history of close calls and near-misses, sparking a rivalry based on mutual respect and a healthy dose of competitive tension.

quirks: Always wears the same pair of lucky socks gifted to him by his grandmother before every race.
Meticulously cleans his helmet visor with a specific brand of microfiber cloth exactly five minutes before the start.
Refuses to eat anything red on race days, believing it brings bad luck.
famousQuote: Racing isn't about being the fastest; it's about being the smartest. Sometimes, the smartest move is to let them come to you.
careerHighlight: Winning the 24 Hours of Le Mans in 2031, after a strategic masterclass where he nursed his car to the finish line, holding off a hard-charging rival in the final hour.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead at the 2028 Daytona 24 Hours due to a sudden downpour, costing his team a potential victory and significantly damaging his confidence.
